result.title: Uncertainty Gates the Gradient: Adaptive Updates for Generalized Few-Shot 3D Segmentation
result.summary: In generalized few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation, support annotations are often compromised by sparsity and occlusion. Blindly adapting to such low quality samples risks learning spurious geometric patterns rather than robust novel concepts. Although 3D Vision-Language Models have been introduced to sup plement supervision, the potential of uncertainty to actively govern adaptation dynamics remains underexplored. Existing signal-level methods like loss reweight ing fail to prevent unreliable episodes from steering the optimization trajectory. To address this, we propose Uncertainty-Gated Adaptive (UGA), to the best of our knowledge the first framework that elevates uncertainty to update-level gating for generalized few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation. The core mod ule, Uncertainty-Gated Update (UG-Update), estimates episodic reliability via intra-class dispersion over merged support and pseudo-labeled novel supervision, and selectively gates residual gradient updates. This encourages the model to learn novel semantics from reliable episodes while attenuating updates during unreliable ones. Complementing this, we introduce an Uncertainty-Based Pseudo Label Filter (UB-Filter) to enforce learning from high-confidence dense signals. On ScanNet200 and ScanNet++ (1-/5-shot), UGA sets new state of the art with an average +3.08 HM IoU over the strongest prior baseline.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向广义 few-shot 3D 点云分割，提出 UGA 框架：以类内离散度估计每个 episode 的可靠性，据此门控残差梯度更新，并用高置信度伪标签过滤来抑制不可靠监督，在 ScanNet200 与 ScanNet++ 上取得领先。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把不确定性从损失加权提升到更新层门控」的做法，可能为 LVR 训练中轨迹监督的可信度加权与不可靠样本的梯度抑制提供可核查线索，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态或 VLM 推理。
